title: Duchesne: Penicillium moulds weaken bacteria
summary: In his 1897 thesis, 23-year-old Ernest Duchesne reported that Penicillium moulds greatly reduced the virulence of bacterial cultures, the first study of moulds' therapeutic power.
why: Anticipated the antibiotic era by three decades.

unsung.contribution: First studied the therapeutic potential of moulds against bacteria.
unsung.recognition: His research went unnoticed; the Institut Pasteur did not acknowledge his thesis, and he was honoured only in 1949.
